info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Refunds API enables users to retrieve detailed information regarding flight refunds for various airline services. This endpoint provides access to refund data, facilitating customer service operations, financial reconciliations, and travel planning. Typical consumers include travel agencies, airline customer support teams, and financial analysts looking to track and manage refund processes effectively. Utilize this API to ensure streamlined access to flight refund information, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information regarding refunds for flights. It facilitates checking the status of refund requests and provides relevant details about the refund process.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refund for a flight. This should contain necessary details for the refund process.
